g.text: Random forest (80 trees) trained on 4 000 synthetic 8-band pixels at launch; each month 3 000 new pixels are classified. The detector loses 0.1-0.6 % of its
gain per month (fastest in the blue band); at month 33 a processing change raises the two short-wave infrared bands by 20 %. PSI: population stability index of
each band against the training data (10 quantile bins); after an alarm the model is retrained on 2 000 newly labelled pixels, which become the new reference.
